text: {"thinking":"Five explanations to test. Demand-driven or batch inference could account for the load, so compare outbound traffic, sampled interconnect traffic and live chip readings. Several independent training runs could each be below the cap, so check customer ownership and compare run timing against cross-cluster traffic. One above-cap run could be split across labels or bills, so compare escrowed allocations with independent traffic and power evidence, and use balance checks to estimate GPU-hours. An unlisted cluster could host an above-cap run, so compare manufacturer inventory with the operator’s system list and check utility energy for unexplained load. Missing records could reflect routine failures during otherwise compliant operations, so check custody and look for independent corroboration on affected days. Start with manufacturer inventory.","action":"inventory","args":{}}
